items.title: [Steam新闻] V2.6.0 His, Her, and Its Wishes
items.summary: Follow the best guide among all the Sherpa,and set out for an altitude of 8,840 meters—Once you reach the summit⛰️,you've arrived at the promised land where all wishes come true."Ta-daa~ the Fairy's radiance🌟 shines upon you now. Go get 'em!"Yes, of course there's a goddess at the snowy mountain's peak!Just like Caraboo's gold coins—it's as real as it gets!Hmm... but before everyone makes their own wish,wouldn't you like to hear... "Its" wish?
